title: Reverse Words in a Sentence
description: Given a sentence containing multiple words, reverse the order of the words while keeping the characters within each word unchanged.
input: A sentence containing multiple words separated by whitespace.
output: The sentence with the order of its words reversed.

examples.explanation: The order of the words is reversed, but the characters within each word remain unchanged.
The words are arranged from last to first.
The two words exchange their positions.
The sentence words are reversed while each individual word remains unchanged.

constraints: Leading and trailing whitespace should not affect the result.

approaches.name: Using Split and Reverse Traversal
approaches.description: Split the sentence into individual words and traverse the resulting array from the last word to the first word to construct the reversed sentence.
approaches.whenToUse: Use when built-in String methods are allowed and the goal is to reverse word order without changing the characters inside each word.

interviewTips: Understand the difference between reversing a string and reversing the order of its words.
Handle multiple spaces and leading or trailing whitespace carefully.
Remember that the characters inside each individual word must remain unchanged.
Be prepared to explain the time and space complexity.
